status: Literature-grounded hypotheses, not an implemented or validated revision

references.title: Adaptive Operator Selection With Bandits for a Multiobjective Evolutionary Algorithm Based on Decomposition
references.authors: Ke Li, Alvaro Fialho, Sam Kwong, Qingfu Zhang
references.paper_facts: FRRMAB records parent-to-offspring fitness improvement rates in a recent sliding window. It ranks operator rewards, applies rank-dependent decay, and uses a UCB-style rule for operator choice. Its experiments concern numerical multiobjective optimization, not LLM program evolution.
references.our_inference: Separate the planner stall criterion from branch-credit calculation. A fixed1-percent gate hid every improvement in the first AHC024 adaptive run; a recent normalized improvement signal is a better-grounded next hypothesis than picking another fixed threshold. Parent-relative reward from the paper is not identical to our global-frontier objective; guard against rewarding weak-branch recovery that never helps the best program. Timing noise still needs explicit treatment.

references.title: JADE: Adaptive Differential Evolution with Optional External Archive
references.paper_facts: The current-to-pbest mutation samples its guiding solution from a top-performing population fraction. An optional archive of replaced parents supplies additional diversity in differential-vector mutation. These operations apply to numerical vectors.
references.our_inference: A program-evolution analogue can explicitly sample valid promising parents rather than rely entirely on planner anchor choice, with an archive for alternative implementations. Code cannot be subtracted like vectors; adapting the idea requires a distinct program-level design and tests. Source-hash diversity alone does not prove conceptual diversity.

next_ablation_order: Finish the current predeclared five-seed comparison; retain all trials, failures and budget truncations.
If reward starvation repeats, change branch credit alone while preserving planner, writer, parent choice and budgets; do not simultaneously change parent selection.
Test an explicit strong-parent-pool policy separately if seed-target restarts dominate.
Only combine individually justified components after their separate development effects are measured.
limits: No novelty claim for classic optimization ideas. No guarantee of improvement from numerical-optimization results. All proposed comparisons remain on development tasks; reserved validation is not used.

cross_task_guardrail.observation: Running AHC058 vanilla Molt trace at44 completed candidates has best5.382173, up from a preceding5.224689. This is larger than1percent, unlike the total gain in the first completed AHC024 adaptive run.
cross_task_guardrail.interpretation: Do not infer that a1-percent credit gate is uninformative on every task. Compare adaptive reward densities separately by task and seed after the frozen campaign finishes. This live vanilla-Molt observation is not a Molt2 performance result.
